query.solvent_accessibility: Biopython ShrakeRupley with fixed golden-spiral sampling; same deposited coordinates for isolated and combined systems
query.surface_context: All selected globin chains plus one HEM at a time; exclude water, phosphate, other HEM instances, hydrogens and symmetry mates
query.alternate_selection: Highest positive occupancy per author atom identity; then lexicographically smallest alternate ID with dot/question treated as blank
query.buried_area: SASA_without_partner minus SASA_with_partner; total is protein plus HEM burial, without dividing by two
